### CVE-2021-25741 — Symlink Exchange Can Allow Host Filesystem Access
- Assigner: kubernetes | Published: 2021-09-20 | Updated: 2024-09-16 | Max CVSS: 8.8
- CWE: CWE-20 CWE-20: Improper Input Validation
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

A security issue was discovered in Kubernetes where a user may be able to create a container with subpath volume mounts to access files & directories outside of the volume, including on the host filesystem.

Affected:
- Kubernetes / Kubernetes: affected unspecified <=1.19.14 (custom); affected unspecified <=1.20.10 (custom); affected unspecified <=1.21.4 (custom); affected unspecified <=1.22.1 (custom)
- kubernetes / kubernetes: affected 0 <=1.19.14 (custom); affected 1.20.0 <=1.20.10 (custom); affected 1.21.0 <=1.21.4 (custom); affected 1.22.0 <=1.22.1 (custom)

Credits: Fabricio Voznika & Mark Wolters

### CVE-2021-25742 — Ingress-nginx custom snippets allows retrieval of ingress-nginx serviceaccount token and secrets across all namespaces
- Assigner: kubernetes | Published: 2021-10-29 | Updated: 2024-09-16 | Max CVSS: 7.6
- CWE: CWE-20 CWE-20: Improper Input Validation
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.6 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:L/A:L`

A security issue was discovered in ingress-nginx where a user that can create or update ingress objects can use the custom snippets feature to obtain all secrets in the cluster.

**workarounds:** This can be mitigated by disallowing snippet annotations on a supported version. Refer to https://github.com/kubernetes/ingress-nginx/issues/7837 for instructions.

Affected:
- Kubernetes / Kubernetes ingress-nginx: affected unspecified <=0.49.0 (custom); unknown next of 0.49.0 <unspecified (custom); affected unspecified <=1.0.0 (custom); unknown next of 1.0.0 <unspecified (custom)

Credits: Mitch Hulscher

References:
- https://groups.google.com/g/kubernetes-security-announce/c/mT4JJxi9tQY [x_refsource_MISC]
- https://github.com/kubernetes/ingress-nginx/issues/7837 [x_refsource_MISC]
- https://security.netapp.com/advisory/ntap-20211203-0001/ [x_refsource_CONFIRM]

### CVE-2021-25745 — Ingress-nginx path can be pointed to service account token file
- Assigner: kubernetes | Published: 2022-05-06 | Updated: 2024-09-16 | Max CVSS: 7.6
- CWE: CWE-20 CWE-20: Improper Input Validation
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.6 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:L/A:L`

A security issue was discovered in ingress-nginx where a user that can create or update ingress objects can use the spec.rules[].http.paths[].path field of an Ingress object (in the networking.k8s.io or extensions API group) to obtain the credentials of the ingress-nginx controller. In the default configuration, that credential has access to all secrets in the cluster.

Affected:
- Kubernetes / Kubernetes ingress-nginx: affected unspecified <1.2.0 (custom)

Credits: Gafnit Amiga

References:
- https://groups.google.com/g/kubernetes-security-announce/c/7vQrpDZeBlc [x_refsource_MISC]
- https://github.com/kubernetes/ingress-nginx/issues/8502 [x_refsource_MISC]
- https://security.netapp.com/advisory/ntap-20220609-0006/ [x_refsource_CONFIRM]

### CVE-2021-25748 — Ingress-nginx `path` sanitization can be bypassed with newline character
- Assigner: kubernetes | Published: 2023-05-24 | Updated: 2025-01-16 | Max CVSS: 7.6
- CWE: CWE-20 CWE-20: Improper Input Validation
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.6 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:L/A:L`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=partial

A security issue was discovered in ingress-nginx where a user that can create or update ingress objects can use a newline character to bypass the sanitization of the `spec.rules[].http.paths[].path` field of an Ingress object (in the `networking.k8s.io` or `extensions` API group) to obtain the credentials of the ingress-nginx controller. In the default configuration, that credential has access to all secrets in the cluster.

Affected:
- Kubernetes / Kubernetes ingress-nginx: affected unspecified <1.2.1 (custom)

Credits: Gafnit Amiga

References:
- https://groups.google.com/g/kubernetes-security-announce/c/avaRYa9c7I8
- https://github.com/kubernetes/ingress-nginx/issues/8686

### CVE-2021-25749 — runAsNonRoot logic bypass for Windows containers
- Assigner: kubernetes | Published: 2023-05-24 | Updated: 2025-01-16 | Max CVSS: 7.8
- CWE: CWE-284 CWE-284 Improper Access Control
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

Windows workloads can run as ContainerAdministrator even when those workloads set the runAsNonRoot option to true.

**solutions:** To mitigate these vulnerabilities, upgrade Kubernetes: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/administer-cluster/cluster-management/#upgrading-a-cluster

Affected:
- Kubernetes / Kubernetes: affected kubelet v1.22.0 - v1.22.13 <v1.22.14 (custom); affected kubelet v1.23.0 - v1.23.10 <v1.23.11 (custom); affected kubelet v1.24.0 - v1.24.4 <v1.24.5 (custom)

Credits: Mark Rosetti (@marosset) of Microsoft

References:
- https://groups.google.com/g/kubernetes-security-announce/c/qqTZgulISzA
